scenario: The ego vehicle attempts a left lane change on a multi-lane city road and collides with the rear of a slowing vehicle in the target lane.

ego.behavior: The car drives forward, initiates a left lane change, and collides with the rear of a vehicle in the left lane.

adversarials.behavior: The car travels forward in the left lane and abruptly slows down, causing the ego vehicle to rear-end it.
The car travels forward ahead of the ego vehicle in the same initial lane.
The car travels forward in the left lane, passing the scene of the collision.

requirements_and_restrictions: The scenario involves a sudden deceleration event in the left lane during a lane change maneuver; the scenario terminates upon collision with the left lane vehicle.

reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: The ego is identified from the first-person dashboard camera perspective.
